title: Camping Outdoor Board
seo_title: Camping Charcuterie Board for 4–8: No-Fridge Shopping List
description: A camping charcuterie board for 4–8: vacuum-packed aged cheddar, Parmesan, summer sausage, pepperoni stick, jerky, dried mango, trail mix and Triscuits.
hook: Pack-in friendly and built around the fire: a camping board of shelf-stable sausage, hard cheese and dried fruit.
why: Whole summer sausage, a pepperoni stick and jerky are made to keep without refrigeration until they're opened, and unopened vacuum-packed aged cheddar and Parmesan are the most travel-proof cheeses you can buy. Slice them at the campsite and nothing goes warm in a pack.

Dried mango and apricots add sweetness, trail mix and dark chocolate add energy, and a few drops of hot sauce wake up the sausage. Rye crispbread and Triscuits survive a backpack. Once opened and sliced, eat it within 2 hours.

timeline.what: Seal everything airtight; pack the board or a cutting board.
Wipe down a flat surface and lay out the board.
Slice the summer sausage and cheddar.
Add the crackers, dried fruit and nuts.

faq.a: Whole, unopened summer sausage, pepperoni sticks, jerky and other shelf-stable dry sausages, plus hard cheeses like Parmesan and vacuum-packed aged cheddar, for short trips. Once opened, keep them cool and eat them within a couple of hours.

faq.q: What crackers survive a camping trip?
faq.a: Sturdy ones like Triscuits, rye crispbread and pita bread.
About 2 to 3 oz each of meat and cheese per person per snack.
